answer: The protocol attaches each agent to a cryptographic trellis of reputation scores that evolve like a glacier, slowly accumulating weight from verified task submissions. Every epoch the median reputation forms a panel; any juror whose score diverges from that median by more than a whisper threshold is automatically slashed, losing their locked stake. To mount a Sybil attack an adversary must pre‑stake the full slashing amount for each fake identity—e.g., 10 ETH per node—and wait the cooling‑off period, making the cost linear in the number of fakes.
